comment: Real repositories scanned by the corpus CI job. The point is to meet the
long tail of lockfile shapes that hand-written fixtures never produce:
big npm monorepos, Django apps, Rust workspaces, Go modules.
Pinned to a commit so a corpus run is reproducible and a failure is
always about deph, never about upstream changing under us.
expect_min_deps guards against a scanner silently regressing to zero.
expect_manifests names what discovery must find in that repo.

repos.name: sindresorhus/got
repos.note: npm library, no lockfile committed: exercises the pyproject-equivalent empty case

repos.name: pallets/flask
repos.note: PEP 621 with ranges: nearly everything should land in unresolved
